# Toolbar (`toolbar`)

Horizontal toolbar and vertical tool rail.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createToolbar` (types in `dist/web/layout/toolbar.d.ts`): `.mh-toolbar` (`--vertical` tool rail, `--floating`): a `role="toolbar"` of controls with `__separator` and `__spacer` items. One tab stop; arrows move between the controls.

```ts
export function createToolbar(options: ToolbarOptions): ToolbarHandle;

export interface ToolbarOptions {
  /** Required: the toolbar's accessible name. */
  label: string;
  items?: readonly ToolbarItem[];
  orientation?: ToolbarOrientation;
  variant?: ToolbarVariant;
}

export interface ToolbarHandle extends ToolbarController {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Adds an item at the end. */
  add(item: ToolbarItem): void;
}

/** A control, a `separator` between groups, or a `spacer` that pushes the rest to the far end. */
export type ToolbarItem = HTMLElement | 'separator' | 'spacer';
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createIconButton, createToolbar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let editing = false;
const edit = createIconButton({
  icon: 'edit',
  label: 'Edit room',
  pressed: editing,
  onClick: () => {
    editing = !editing;
    edit.setPressed(editing);
  },
});

const toolbar = createToolbar({
  label: 'Floor plan',
  items: [
    createIconButton({ icon: 'arrow-left', label: 'Undo' }).el,
    createIconButton({ icon: 'arrow-right', label: 'Redo' }).el,
    'separator',
    createIconButton({ icon: 'add', label: 'Add device' }).el,
    edit.el,
    'spacer',
    createButton({ label: 'Done', size: 'small' }).el,
  ],
});

document.body.append(toolbar.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`IconButton` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createIconButton`.

```ts
export function IconButton({ icon, label, tone, size, filled, pressed, className, ...rest }: IconButtonProps);

export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'> {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the accessible name (also the tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  filled?: boolean;
  pressed?: boolean;
}
```

`Toolbar` (types in `dist/react/layout.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createToolbar`; the roving tab stop comes from `bindToolbar`.

```ts
export function Toolbar({ label, orientation = 'horizontal', variant, className, children }: ToolbarProps);

export interface ToolbarProps {
  label: string;
  orientation?: ToolbarOrientation;
  variant?: ToolbarVariant;
  className?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`ToolbarSeparator` (types in `dist/react/layout.d.ts`): A rule between groups of toolbar controls.

```ts
export function ToolbarSeparator();
```

`ToolbarSpacer` (types in `dist/react/layout.d.ts`): Pushes the following toolbar controls to the far end.

```ts
export function ToolbarSpacer();
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, IconButton, Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator, ToolbarSpacer } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ToolbarExample() {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Toolbar label="Floor plan">
      <IconButton icon="arrow-left" label="Undo" />
      <IconButton icon="arrow-right" label="Redo" />
      <ToolbarSeparator />
      <IconButton icon="add" label="Add device" />
      <IconButton icon="edit" label="Edit room" pressed={editing} onClick={() => setEditing(!editing)} />
      <ToolbarSpacer />
      <Button size="small">Done</Button>
    </Toolbar>
  );
}
```
